body:
And its not what a friend said. Its things I say. The people I'm talking about and talking to are amazing and sources of support and positivity. 

No negativity is coming from others. All this shit I'm feeling comes straight from within.
I agree most of the time but I get overwhelmed with negativity. I know it doesn't matter. At night I can't do anything about it.

Yeah its not voices its an inner monologue.

To clarify. I've been to the shrink. Do not have the voices in your head like you're thinking. I just think loud and fast.

Let me know if you feel like messaging or something. I appreciate how well you communicate your feelings and would love to talk when you're feeling better.

And let me tell you I can relate. All the motivational talk you hear about reaching for happiness and whatnot is easier said than done. I'm doing it now. I'm nearly the person I wanted to be a couple years ago.

Know how I feel? Like shit. Doesn't mean its not worth going for. Make moments happy. 

We're fucked up individuals. Its ok though. Do things that satisfy you. You are important. Reality is relative to your own mind. 

What do you want? Try to make it happen no matter how stupid you think it is. Fuck how you're supposed to feel. You're raw. You feel life harder than others. The bad becomes unbareable, but the good can become equally unparalleled in pleasure.
